products.name: Duck Soap Dish — WITH Feet
products.description:
Add a unique, fun touch to your bathroom or kitchen while keeping your soap neat and dry. Our Duck Soap Dish features a clever built-in drain, directing excess water directly into your sink or tub to prevent soggy soap. We print these delightful ducks right here in the USA, made to order just for you, using durable, eco-friendly PLA plastic. This specific listing is for our standing duck design with adorable feet, but we also offer a version resting on its belly, and an extra large, mallard-colored duck, all available in separate listings.

*   Perfect for bars of soap, sponges, or even small trinkets by the sink.
*   Includes one 3D printed Duck Soap Dish (WITH Feet style).
*   Choose from our wide palette of vibrant colors to match your decor!
*   Hand wash with mild soap and water. Not dishwasher safe.

Pick your favorite color and we'll custom print your duck friend today!

products.name: Portable Cable Organizer / Winder
products.description: A portable cable organizer which is setup as an easy print-in-place and includes a knob on the side for conveniently winding up the cable when you're ready to pack it away. This model is an easy print that requires no supports, and three different sizes are provided to accommodate cables of different lengths. If you're not sure which to choose, I'd recommend starting with the “medium” size.   After printing, you'll want to place the cable within the groove at its halfway point, close the lid (which is intentionally designed to close tightly), wind up the cord clockwise using the handle, and then extend by simply grabbing the cable by both ends .   Update:   Alternative smooth-sided versions of all three sizes have now been added, and also the handle design was slightly adjusted to add a small fillet and chamfer to decrease the bridge distance.
